hero.notes: Full-width hero background. To use a different photo: add it to images/, add an entry under "images" (widths up to the original width, ideally 1920px or more), run npm run images, and set "image" to its id. To use a video: put an .mp4 (muted, ideally under 6 MB, 10-20 seconds) in src/media/, set "type" to "video", "video" to the file name and "videoPoster" to an image id shown while it loads. The current photo is a 1080px stand-in and will look soft on large screens.
